title: cf-detail-panel — provenance revealed without covering the evidence it explains

findings.method: checked = the 9 contrast pairs in the payload's measurement table, computed from design-system/tokens/tokens.json release 0.2.0 by resolving the alias chain to a hex and applying WCAG relative luminance (Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B on linearised sRGB), ratio = (Yl + 0.05) / (Yd + 0.05), all re-derived on demand by verify-contrast.py in this directory at a tolerance of 0.002. found = 3: (1) semantic.layer.02 is #ffffff and measures 1.181:1 against palette.bone.default, so a white panel on the bone ground has no visible boundary and the semantic.border.strong-01 edge (4.253:1) is mandatory — elevation.surface.raised cannot substitute, because a shadow is an alpha over the ground and carries no guaranteed contrast; (2) semantic.border.subtle-01 measures 1.708:1 even against the panel's own white surface, so it fails the 3:1 non-text floor on both grounds and cannot be used as any boundary that carries meaning anywhere in this system; (3) release 0.2.0 has NO layout or size axis — the spacing scale tops out at spacing.13 = 10rem — so no token can express a side-panel width, which is resolved by giving the panel no width of its own rather than by inventing a value. skipped = 5 checks not run and claimed in neither direction: no render; no keyboard walk; no screen-reader pass; no forced-colors render; no touch test. Every behaviour in the focus-management sequence is specified and none is observed. Skipped is not passed.

notes.this_is_a_proposal: Nothing here is in design-system/component-index.json and this artifact did not write to it. Promotion is explicit human approval recorded as an ADR (CLAUDE.md, 'The membrane') and screen-producer cannot perform it.
notes.level_1_is_contested_and_says_so: This is the weakest classification in the batch and the payload argues both sides rather than picking one quietly. For level 1: ADR-012's own test is that L1 needs tokens, brand.md and the primitive set while L2 needs the component library, Code Connect and the MCP — this component needs none of the three. Against: it carries required scripted behaviour (focus management, Escape, aria-expanded) and no existing level-1 primitive does. Deciding it for now: validation/adapters/carbon-react.py would erase a CoForge-authored level 2 entry on its next run, so level 2 is currently a lossy destination. That is a repository defect, not a justification, and validation.md reports it as one.
notes.batch_wide_audit_lives_here: This artifact's validation.md section 7 carries the single after-run of validation/audit-system.py covering all four specs in this batch (ART-017 to ART-020), with a finding-level diff against the before-run rather than a count comparison. The other three validation.md files point here rather than each running the audit against a registry that was deliberately half-written at the time.
notes.why_a_new_workstream: design-system-authoring did not exist. brand-foundations is the brand and its tokens, design-system-selection is which vendor system to adopt, luma-travel is a client research thread, system-operations is the operating cost of the agent apparatus. A proposal to enter component-index.json is none of those. Same reasoning ART-010 recorded when it created system-operations.
